reviews.title: Scam of the year!!!!
reviews.text: $499 for over 20 markers and so far the only thing it has kept track of his glucose… So in conjunction to the $499 per year is now an $89 a month charge for glucose monitors. And while that by itself is on a completely different app, this company is 100% a scam because there’s not a single solitary thing that it measures other than glucose that it said it was going to measure. If you’re thinking about getting this go a different route because there’s not a thing about it that it’s worthwhile. You ended up having to download two apps and if you want to track your meals and activities, etc., you have to input the information twice (once in each app) because the only thing the two apps communicate to one another is glucose levels and nothing else. When you look at the website, it sounds great. Looks very enticing but when you get the app, you have this misunderstanding this company is interested only in your money and not giving you a finished product. I am very thankful that I did not do the $2000 version.

reviews.title: Bad app bad return policy
reviews.text: Wouldn’t refund since is was outside the meager 14 day return policy. If you don’t have glucose monitor don’t use. Bad customer service!

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.text: This is a great app. I am learning so much about what kind of foods affects me and how I can adjust to control my glucose levels.

reviews.title: Could be great
reviews.text: The one thing really holding this app back is the HORRIBLE food log. PLEASE just get meal data/nutrients from Apple Health or integrate with Lose-It. The native food tracking is terrible. Even logging the food in Lose-it and taking screenshots of the meal, the Levels Ai sucks at getting the macros correct. It’s wrong more than half the time. If they fix this, it would be so much more useful!

reviews.title: Underwhelmed
reviews.text: Overpriced, AI is bad, coaching is very elementary level for the money.

reviews.title: Levels, a Great Guide
reviews.text: Levels is helping me as I try to lower my A12 and my ApoB.  They have helped me set realistic goals and follow a routine that has made a positive difference.  With the CGM, I can see the difference my diet makes.  Levels is like a good friend encouraging me to make the best decisions. .

reviews.title: Good tracking terrible AI coach, gives wrong information
reviews.text: I have used Levels a few times and usually for a period of time with the glucose monitor to calibrate my eating exercise and overall health. The app is easy to use and does the basics well (5 ⭐️). They now have an AI coach, which is truly terrible (1 ⭐️ or less). I am well-versed in and understand how AI works, especially large language, models and AI for analysis. This “coach” not only gives you bad advice it sometimes pulls the wrong data and then confidently analyzes it. On the misguided advice -  I had a spike due to stress with a perfectly balanced meal that I ate a little bit before. It confidently said I might want to reconsider the meal.  When I shared the meal back and reminded it of the event I tracked at the same time, it basically said, oh yeah you’re right, my bad, this is a really well balanced meal, maybe it’s stress. I have screenshots of all of this. It also has pulled the wrong data claiming I had a glucose drop in the evening when it actually happened in the middle of the night. We went back-and-forth three times and it really couldn’t understand that the time period it had was wrong. I actually fed some of the answers and screenshots into another AI tool and that AI tool basically said that’s terrible. It’s suggested I write a letter and that I didn’t need it for the analysis so I should stop using it. 😂 Bottom line - use the app but use the AI coach very cautiously. To the developers this AI coach needs a lot of work and you may want to reconsider how you released it and how your advertising it within the app. It is a liability especially for people who are looking for solid analysis and feedback.

reviews.title: Complete waste of time and money
reviews.text: This app is not user friendly, provides no useable information. It’s so bad that it feels like it can’t be incompetence this feels like it might be a scam. The overall rating of 4.7 does not seem plausible. Do not purchase. Something is wrong. This is so bad I am looking for an oversight or regulatory board to report it.

reviews.title: It’s been essential for me
reviews.text: I didn’t know I had prediabetes, so getting Levels has been a game changer for me in reducing glucose levels. I couldn’t do without it. Knowing I can see what effect foods have on my blood sugar levels influences what I choose to eat!

reviews.title: Best tool for your health!
reviews.text: Fantastic tool to live your best life!

reviews.title: Cannot stop billing
reviews.text: Signed up for levels, unfortunately there was a typo in my email. I have contacted support multiple times to cancel and they have yet to respond.

reviews.title: 72 and changing my macros
reviews.text: I always had a clean and whole diet, but was getting close too to being diabetic and my cholesterol was too high. This tool has helped me to: double my protein and my fiber intake; control my blood sugar levels throughout the day; and get rid of cortisol spikes that awakened me in the middle of the night; and best of all I don’t have to go on medication and still eat the same foods, just differently.

reviews.title: Levels is a game changer
reviews.text: I love Levels. It has changed my life by giving me true insight into how food affects my health and well being. Small invest for the most important asset in your life, you.

reviews.title: Maybe good for some, not for me
reviews.text: The app user interface is colors on black, hard to see. The app has many possible functions; it is unnecessarily complex and complicated. After 2 weeks of use, I haven’t found my way around it though I’m no novice. It adds to my stress level. I will try other CGM/nutrition apps.

reviews.title: Levels total system
reviews.text: Has everything needed to succeed long term.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Started with good energy book last fall 9/24, levels app 1/25, CGM 5/25.   CGM data is invaluable with AI meal suggestions.  Food cravings gone, feel full and cells healthy.  Down 25 lbs! 165lbs to 140lbs.   No pre diabetes or diabetes diagnosis, however I was undiagnosed insulin resistant and no longer. I recommend the book, app, CGM to everyone!

reviews.title: Bad experience in iOS 26.1
reviews.text: I have used and loved Levels for about a year. I upgraded my iPhone- downloaded the Levels updates and the app runs 3 hours behind reading the cgm.  The “Help” feature doesn’t load… really not helpful anymore and no way to contact them for help.

reviews.title: Freezes constantly
reviews.text: Just bought a 1 year subscription since I’ve used this app previously and loved it. I am a little concerned because the app keeps freezing causing me to close and reopen. Not the best user experience. I’m hoping the next update will fix it.

reviews.title: Great software, but fails because of a dependency
reviews.text: Excellent app in what it does, but fails miserably because it depends on Stelo for OTC CGMs — genuinely makes it almost useless, if it were not for the library of really helpful articles.  Metrics are a waste, because Stelo CGMs are simply inaccurate and unreliable (read the plethora of feedback online).  Do your own research, but please investigate to save you time and frustration.  The staff at Levels are superb and I hope whatever it is that is preventing them from using Lingo and others (if others) can be resolved.  However, Levels should really disclose the Stelo dilemma to their potential customer before they subscribe.  I had to cancel.

reviews.title: Not for medical glucose patients
reviews.text:
Their recent announcement to stop support for medical grade CGMs, such as the Dexcom G7, shows what this company truly is: a vanity app for the insanely rich and streaming influencer types. 

While the service did provide health benefits while my CGM was fully supported, their recent moves to discontinue real time support for medical CGMs and their insanely priced membership fee updates shows this is clearly not an app for diabetics and pre-diabetics who clearly benefit this most from their service. 

If you fall into the medical camp of glucose monitoring: don't bother. They want to sell you on services you don't need and labs you can already get through your doctor. 

Also, their "AI" meal evaluation system half works at best. The real power was in manual meal input by the item. Very tedious and manual.

reviews.title: Tracking Food is Awkward
reviews.text: Feedback from the CGM is useful, the food tracking feature is awkward and testing isn’t available in my area so I’m using Function.

reviews.title: Auto-renewal scam
reviews.text: Will bait you with an affordable yearly price, and then double it without warning when it renews, even if you haven’t used it in 6 months. Still waiting for a refund

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: When I got levels and my cgm it changed everything. I learned so much about how my specific body works. Helped me build some real lifestyle habits! Thank you, Levels!

reviews.text: Even though Libre 3 has been discontinued by abbot. We still had sensors that were working and now there’s way to add them. Also at $50 per month, it’s way overpriced… do better guys z

reviews.title: Main menu freezes when input is made
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for a year… didn’t have any issues, but now the main menu freezes whenever input is made and the screen has to be refreshed.  This also happens under different menu.

reviews.title: Auto-renewal
reviews.text: Got a CGM for my birthday, 30-day observation. It’s been awesome! But was charged $40 for another month’s subscription automatically. Beware! Don’t make the same mistake as me, turn off the auto-renewal asap!

reviews.title: No mmol measurement!!
reviews.text: Does not support displaying glucose values in mmol/L (the SI unit commonly used outside the U.S.). Such an easy thing to fix - don’t know why they won’t let user choose measurement metrics.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work for visually impaired people; otherwise terrific
A.I.
reviews.text: Being able to dictate my meals to the AI description feature is a game changer

reviews.title: Tremendously helpful!!
reviews.text: Wearing my CGM, I was floored by what spiked my glucose. I was able to make adjustments and experiment with different food orders and food items and learn real time how they affected me. It’s being able to see how I process food. It’s different for everyone. I joined the levels app and got the CGM’s. I have more CGM’s then I need and canceled the subscription without issues. Not even a pop up asking if I’m sure I want to cancel. If in the future I need more I would sign up again. The Levels app is also very helpful in keeping a diary of my food intake and CGM readings. Honestly I only used the levels app when I wore a CGM. You can take a pic of what you eat and see how your glucose reacted. It also connects to your iwatch so my exercise was uploaded to. I went from a 70 stability score to a 98% stability score. Highly recommend these should be used before you actually get diabetes which is the case for me because that was the path I was on for sure!

reviews.title: leveling up
reviews.text: Hadn’t used this app in a while, and I’m so impressed by the positive changes.  This is all I need in order to dial in my nutrition.  The food logs have come a long way.  Just awesome.

reviews.title: Daily Scores too harsh
reviews.text:
I have excellent metabolic health, < 50g carbs a day, healthy mediterranean diet with nutrition, exercise and sleep all dialed in. I have zero insulin resistance. I don’t eat any junk food whatsoever. Blood glucose never above 120, fasting glucose 81, hba1c 5.1%.

Daily scores are in the 70s. Whatever algorithm you use is too punishing and would be demoralizing to anyone starting out with app. Why such low numbers?

I’ve worn a CGM daily for over 2 years and know exactly how my body works. If my glucose is 80 and then rises 25 points I get dinged with a meal
score of 6. You need a smarter algorithm that rewards healthy lifestyle. It’s too heavily weighted in one metric.

I cannot see the benefit of renewing my membership.

reviews.text: Evil

reviews.text: Love the immediate feed back!

reviews.title: Perfect app for true health
reviews.text: I love this app, it includes so much information not only about what you have done but what you can do to improve.  I looked at this app for a long time but never pulled the trigger because of the price point, big mistake.  Regardless of your situation, it can help you.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: The app only allows adjustment of protein macros. If you have fitness goals like cutting or bulking, it’s not very useful. I ended up using both this app and MyFitnessPal. I tried the glucose monitoring feature, but it exaggerates the spikes when compared to the stelo app and my oura ring.

reviews.title: Great Tracker
reviews.text: I’m a geek for data. I enjoy seeing the science behind what my body is doing. This tracker makes it easy to log food and see how my body responds. It’s also great for accountability.

reviews.title: Cannot even create an account in this app
reviews.text:
I installed the app. Opening it first time it asks for my email and password, without giving the option to create an account in the first place. I am baffled.

Even more incongruously, on the "Welcome to Levels" page that shows the sign in dialog and that appears when opening the app, there is a back arrow "<" in the upper left hand corner. But tapping that arrow just brings back the same page.

However app really needs dedicated IPAD version as this would broadly increase its utility. Please add this!

reviews.text: Very useful app for seeing relationship between foods consumed and blood sugar responses.  Only wish is for an Apple Watch companion to easily see rings throughout the day.

reviews.text: Pricing is out of this world. You can find apps that charge you 5$ a month and they are way better than this like Bevel app. One star and if i can rate it 0 i would.

reviews.title: Levels calorie tracking
reviews.text: The Levels app calorie tracking is so easy. I don’t have to think about it. Just take a picture and review it to see that it has all the ingredients correct and voilà my calorie count is done. My macro nutrients are done and it keeps perfect record of everything. Never had it so good.

reviews.title: Can’t add meals
reviews.text: App win fails to add meals, only exercises.  I’ve been contacting support about the fact the app has never worked. The app will not allow me to log my meals. I contacted support and was told to try enter via the camera, scan the barcode, type it in, or speak it in. I’ve tried all of those methods and none worked. I informed support about this and no one had replied. It also won’t alls my habits to be entered. Chat support tells you to send e-mail for help. Auto-response said they’re swamped with so many emails and to be patient. I’ve never heard back. All I want is my money back.

reviews.title: Game changer
reviews.text: I have been struggling to lose weight. The feedback of this app with a CGM has given me the knowledge and incentive I need and I am finally seeing progress!  It is so much easier to stay consistent with because of the ease of logging meals. I had never been able to keep up with MyFitnessPal but have only missed one day logging on this since I started.

reviews.title: No create account button
reviews.text: Everyone has been telling me how great levels App is. However, when I went to sign up, I discovered that for some reason there is no create account option. I have searched the Internet and asked people I know, but no one can tell me how to create an account maybe someone from Levels will read this and actually put proper directions on how to an account.  Remember on my screen, there is no create or sign up button or link.
